questions.prompt: If Alex misses a lesson, he ___ for the notes.
If we finish early, we ___ our answers.
If she has a question, she ___ the teacher.

Прочитай текст і визнач правильну відповідь.

Alex missed school on Tuesday. He had sent a message to his teacher before the lesson started. Later his friend called and asked how he felt. Alex said that he had a headache and wanted to rest. On Friday he returned to school and collected the notes. If he misses a lesson, he asks a classmate what the class studied.

What had Alex done before the lesson?
